title: The importance of tensor handling and implementation of physics-informed DeepONets
abstract: arXiv:2610.22157v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) reduce or eliminate the need for large labelled datasets by enforcing governing equations during training. Physics-informed Deep Operator Networks (PI-DeepONets) extend this approach to learning solution operators, enabling rapid prediction across families of problems. Despite these advantages, we show that their application to higher-dimensional problems remains limited by the computational cost of training. To address this issue, we propose a modified PI-DeepONet architecture that reduces this cost by removing redundancy in how the Branch network processes input functions across collocation points. The proposed formulation is mathematically equivalent to the original architecture but reduces input tensor sizes and the number of Branch network evaluations. We analyse the computational complexity of both architectures and derive theoretical scaling laws for training time with respect to the number

translated_title: 物理信息DeepONet中张量处理与实现的重要性
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）通过在训练过程中施加控制方程，减少或消除了对大规模标注数据集的需求。物理信息深度算子网络（PI-DeepONets）将这一方法扩展到学习解算子，能够对一系列问题实现快速预测。尽管具有这些优势，我们表明其在高维问题上的应用仍然受到训练计算成本的限制。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种改进的PI-DeepONet架构，通过消除Branch网络在各配置点处理输入函数时的冗余来降低这一成本。所提出的公式在数学上与原始架构等价，但减小了输入张量的尺寸并减少了Branch网络的评估次数。我们分析了两种架构的计算复杂度，并推导出了训练时间关于数量的理论缩放定律。
tldr: 提出一种与原架构数学等价的改进PI-DeepONet，通过消除Branch网络处理输入函数时的冗余，减小输入张量规模和网络评估次数，从而显著降低高维问题的训练计算成本。
en_tdlr: We propose a modified PI-DeepONet architecture that is mathematically equivalent to the original but removes redundancy in Branch network processing, reducing input tensor sizes and network evaluations to significantly lower training costs for higher-dimensional problems.
